structure.unit: Prisons and Other Methods of Correction
Crimes and Criminal Proceedings Involving Prisoners

law.catch_line: If prisoner commits any other felony, how punished
law.text: If a prisoner in a state, local or community correctional facility or in the custody of an employee thereof commits any felony other than those specified in §§ 18.2-31, 18.2-55 and 53.1-203, which is punishable by confinement in a state correctional facility, such prisoner shall be subject to the same punishment therefor as if he were not a prisoner.
